headline: GIFT Nifty signals positive start for Sensex and Nifty as crude oil prices decline

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty rose nearly 200 points signaling a strong opening for Indian benchmark indices.
Crude oil prices fell over 1% to 2% as Iran-Qatar talks to end the war continue.
Axis AMC expects Indian stocks to recover on steady growth and corporate earnings.
Global and Asian markets remain mixed while investors weigh lower oil against external cues.
whatHappening: GIFT Nifty traded significantly higher, pointing toward early gains for Sensex and Nifty 50.
Crude oil dropped towards $111 per barrel amid ongoing peace negotiations in the Middle East.
Reliance Industries (RIL) is among the key stocks in focus as trading opens on November 2.
Technical indicators show six stocks breaking above their 200-day moving averages.
summary:
Indian markets are positioned for a higher start on November 2, led by strong GIFT Nifty cues.
Declining crude oil prices amid ongoing Middle East talks offer relief to domestic equities.
Key heavyweights including Reliance Industries remain in focus as markets track steady earnings and global developments.
